개꿀잼 ㅠㅠㅠ 후회공은 왜 항상 별점이 낮은지

I found the psychological premise of this story much more interesting than the romance itself. While I appreciated the themes of regret, obsession, and second chances, the emotional development didn't always feel convincing to me. The single POV also became repetitive at times, making parts of the story drag. Still, it wasn't boring, and it had enough compelling moments to keep me reading. If you enjoy darker relationship dynamics and character-driven psychological stories, it might be worth trying, but it wasn't a standout read for me.
